title: Buffer tape and input symbol
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean input word $w$, and state set $S$. If the input head is at position $p$, then the buffer tape storing $w$, read at integer cell $p-1$, contains exactly the optional symbol read by the input head of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes, Boolean alphabet, state set $S$, and input $w$
replaced:
Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes over the Boolean
alphabet whose input is the word $w$, and let $p \in \{0,\dots,\abs{w}+1\}$
be its input-head position.  Cell $p - 1$ of the buffer tape storing $w$
holds exactly the symbol scanned by the input head of $c$: the corresponding
input symbol at interior positions, and a blank at the two boundary
positions.
